categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in two segments: internet acceleration services focused on network games and mobile internet software advertising and subscription services. The internet acceleration segment includes PC and mobile game accelerators that optimize network performance for gamers. The advertising segment involves personalized tool applications and casual games, generating revenue through subscriptions and third-party advertising platforms.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes proprietary intelligent network acceleration technologies including smart cloud acceleration platforms (SCAP), intelligent routing, acceleration node deployment, and smart acceleration algorithms. It integrates acceleration modules into game clients, mobile ROMs, chipsets, and routers. The company also applies AI and AIGC technologies for data analysis, fault prediction, and algorithm optimization to enhance user experience.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are individual gamers, especially heavy and competitive players of PC and mobile games, and internet users of mobile applications. The company also serves enterprise clients requiring network optimization through B2B SaaS services. The advertising business targets global advertisers and mobile app users in both domestic China and overseas markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company mainly operates in China, with 99.18% of revenue generated domestically. It also has overseas operations and subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Singapore, focusing on advertising services and network acceleration. The company’s network acceleration services and advertising platforms cover global internet users.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the internet service supply chain, providing network acceleration services and software applications directly to end users and collaborating with game developers, hardware manufacturers, and advertising platforms. It acts as a service provider and platform operator rather than a hardware manufacturer.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on expanding intelligent network services globally, deepening vertical industry applications, and innovating in multi-scenario intelligent network adaptation. R&D priorities include continuous iteration of network acceleration algorithms, AI-driven data analytics, AIGC technology integration, and expanding product functionalities to enhance user retention and experience.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through subscription fees for network acceleration services (B2C and B2B2C models), service contracts with enterprise clients (B2B SaaS), and advertising sales via mobile applications (B2B). The company also earns from third-party advertising platforms and cooperates with operators and channel partners for revenue sharing.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player and industry leader in China’s PC and mobile game acceleration market, with strong market presence, user base, and technological advantages. It holds competitive advantages in network resources, technology, marketing, and operational efficiency. It collaborates closely with major game developers and hardware manufacturers, reinforcing its dominant position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 297.4 million, a 19.76% decline from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 20.5 million, down 30.12%. The company has a total asset base of about RMB 897 million and equity attributable to shareholders of RMB 622 million. Despite revenue decline, the company maintains a stable user base and continues investing in R&D with a 19.69% revenue ratio.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes superior network acceleration technology that significantly reduces latency, login difficulties, and disconnections for competitive gamers, enhancing fairness and user experience. Its SCAP platform offers scalable, intelligent acceleration services with patented technologies for backbone and Wi-Fi acceleration. The company’s integrated ecosystem and strong partnerships provide differentiated, high-quality services tailored to heavy and competitive gaming users.
